name: Sorvilán (Spain)
description: Green field charged with a white tower between two yellow ears of wheat, with a white and a blue stripe along the lower edge.
history: Sorvilán adopted its arms and flag officially on 22 March 2001; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, green, with a white tower between two yellow ears of wheat and white and blue stripes along the lower edge representing the coast.

features.role: ears of wheat flanking the tower
white and blue stripes along the lower edge
